description: Powerful 850W Copper Motor Performance – BUILDSKILL rotary hammer drill machine heavy duty model is equipped with an 850W copper motor that delivers stable power and reduces heat build-up, making it ideal for concrete, wood, and steel drilling. 4 Functional Modes for Complete Versatility – Switch seamlessly between Drilling, Hammer Drilling, Chiseling, and Light Demolition. These modes make the rotary hammer drilling machine perfect for construction work, tile removal, and home renovation tasks. Variable Speed & Forward/Reverse Control – Offers better accuracy whether you’re drilling clean holes or removing screws. The 1100 RPM variable speed lets you control torque for professional-grade hammer drill machine applications. SDS Plus Chuck for Quick Bit Changes – Features a 26mm SDS Plus chuck that ensures secure locking and quick bit replacement. Compatible with multiple SDS bits, making this rotary tool suitable for various drilling and chiseling needs. High Impact Efficiency – 3 Joules & 4900 BPM – The strong impact system delivers 3J energy and 4900 blows/min, helping you break concrete, chip tiles, and drill anchor holes efficiently. Supports 26mm concrete, 30mm wood, and 13mm steel drilling, ideal for demanding hammer tool jobs. Continuous Lock Button for Long Working Hours – No need to hold the trigger during repeated drilling. The lock-on button ensures comfort during extended use, ideal for labor-intensive rotary hammer drilling machine operations. Ergonomic TPR Grip & 360° Adjustable Handle – Designed for comfort, the anti-slip TPR grip minimizes vibration while the auxiliary handle provides balance and precision. Essential for safe use of any heavy-duty hammer tool. What is in the box? : BUILDSKILL Rotary Hammer Drilling Machine is equipped with, 1 x 850W Copper Rotary Hammer with auxiliary handle & depth gauge, 1 x pointed chisel, 1 x flat chisel, 6.8.10mm drill bits. All this is packed in a hard BMC case for easy & safe transportation, User Manual. Warranty and Customer Support : 6 months warranty, For any product queries, replacements, or warranty assistance, please reach out to our BUILDSKILL Customer Care team. (Available Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 5:30 PM)
